programs.title: Gaisrai
programs.desc: Anna Arnardóttir, a renowned volcanologist, notices signs of dangerous eruptions near Reykjavík.Despite the warnings, the authorities do not believe her.The affair with the photographer also complicates the woman's private life.

programs.title: Sanctuary
programs.desc: Hal Porterfield (Christopher Abbott) orders room service at a posh hotel.Rebecca Marin (Margaret Qualley) shows up at the apartment to interview him for the position of general manager of this chain of facilities.Her questions become more and more personal and lead to a surprising ending.In reality, the woman is a dominatrix who follows the script prepared by Hal.However, the relationship does not follow the script ordered by the client.The woman decides to blackmail the rich man.She claims that she recorded a compromising sex tape with him.

programs.title: This is the end
programs.desc: A series of paranormal events take place in Los Angeles, reminiscent of the end of the world.As a result of the chaos in the city, a group of friends are trapped in an apartment.Unfortunately, their situation is becoming more and more dramatic by the minute: they are running out of food and free space, which gives rise to conflicts.Finally, having no other choice, they decide to leave the apartment and face the chaos outside.The wacky comedy is the directorial debut of two comedians: Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg.In addition to brilliant humor, the film is full of fierce irony directed at American celebrities.The main roles were played by: James Franco ("Citizen Milk", "127 Hours"), Jonah Hill ("Moneyball", "The Wolf of Wall Street"), Danny McBride ("Divine Chillout", the series "It Could Be Worse"), Emma Watson ("Harry Potter") and singer Rihanna.

programs.title: House of the Dragon 2
programs.sub_title: The Red Dragon and the Gold
programs.desc: The second series of the production, the events of which precede the action of "Game of Thrones".After the death of Lucerys Velaryon, the son of Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen (Emma D'Arcy), which was caused by his cousin, Aemond Targaryen (Ewan Mitchell), Westeros finds itself on the brink of a bloody civil war.The Green Council supporting King Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney) and Queen Rhaenyra's Black Council are fighting for influence.Each side claims the Iron Throne.The dynamic development of events also affects the attitude of Rhaenyra's husband, Daemon (Matt Smith), in life.A man who spends a lot of time in Harrenhal Castle, away from his wife, changes a lot.In addition, the demons of his past begin to haunt him.

programs.title: Peacemaker 2
programs.desc: Two years have passed since the last events.Chris Smith (John Cena) considers himself a real hero.However, he must earn the recognition of other heroes.

programs.title: The Order
programs.desc: 1983, Idaho.FBI agent Terry Husk (Jude Law) with the help of local policeman Jamie Bowen (Tye Sheridan) takes down a far-right terrorist group.The criminals are led by Bob Mathews (Nicholas Hoult), who, together with his men, commits daring robberies.Neo-Nazis intend to use the looted funds to start a revolution and overthrow the US government.They draw inspiration from the apocalyptic novel "The Turner Diaries" about race war.In 1984, they kill liberal journalist Alan Berg (Marc Maron).Finally, there is a bloody confrontation between law enforcement officers and bandits.Scenario based on facts.
